notes: Faster: big chats, typing and switching pages are much smoother
No more getting the same message notification twice on one phone or computer
Profile studio scrolls properly on computers and iPads
Pick your country once to show friends your local time — and choose who sees it. Only the time is shown, never where you live
Incoming calls now fill the whole screen with a ringtone and vibration, like WhatsApp — Answer, Decline or 'Can't talk'
